source_conclusions: Microsoft specifies that a nonzero Number-Of-Filters11 overrides Number-Of-Filters1. Collector now withholds binary layouts it cannot verify instead of silently accepting a mismatch.
Microsoft specifies table alignment may exist. Reader now uses declared ctypes structures and table field offsets, checks returned length, and handles one bounded size-growth retry.
Microsoft specifies Select-Object -First can stop upstream enumeration. Collector now reads at most limit+1, reports truncation, and caps exported arrays for both direct and batch paths.
limitations: Administrator read-only native run remains unverified; no elevation retried in this source-review round.
No authenticated customer router login is claimed.
Windows IPv4 collector only; no router operation or UI changes.
